description: Narrow and elongated. Living bright bedrooms dim. Deep — views through multiple spaces. No internal corridor — fully open layout. Kitchen: single-wall, no island or peninsula — counter set back from windows, moderate natural light. Cook faces the wall — back to the living and dining area. One active cook at a time. Fully open plan — no wall separates kitchen from dining and living. Living arrangement: linear kitchen-dining-living, kitchen on side wall. Seating: single sofa against the right exterior wall facing inward toward the room. Dining table (4 seats). Entry: direct into kitchen, first thing visible on arrival is kitchen. No door between entry and living — relevant where local regulations require separation. Master suite (en-suite bathroom) — accessed via through living, no walk-in wardrobe. Master bedroom is only accessible through the living room — no direct corridor access, least private position. Master suite (en-suite bathroom) closest to entry — lighter acoustic separation from the arrival zone. Storage: one wardrobe. One bathroom (shower, bathtub, and toilet). Single bathroom — all household members share one shower, sequential morning routine. Suits: singles or couples. Not suitable for: families with children (only one bedroom); people needing a home office (no desk space or dedicated room); households requiring two separate sleeping areas; those wanting a generous wardrobe or storage (only one wardrobe, no storage room).
